STS2WD-ASELIGE.pages.DONE.description: You receive a blessing from Aselige.
STS2WD-ASELIGE.pages.INITIAL.description: A great green dragon welcomes you.
STS2WD-ASELIGE.talk.ANY.0-0r.ancient: You sold your soul to a contemptible being. Poor thing.
STS2WD-ASELIGE.talk.ANY.0-2r.ancient: Even if I killed you here, you would remain a puppet. Let me offer a little help.
STS2WD-ASELIGE.talk.ANY.10-0r.ancient: A verdant forest… It may not be my garden, but it seems a wonderful place.
STS2WD-ASELIGE.talk.ANY.10-1r.ancient: Or… perhaps I have rather biased tastes?
STS2WD-ASELIGE.talk.ANY.1-0r.ancient: That ceaseless desire to improve brought you here. Do you seek the greatest hunt?
STS2WD-ASELIGE.talk.ANY.11-0r.ancient: Even if you have not given up, you may rest a moment before starting again.
STS2WD-ASELIGE.talk.ANY.12-0r.ancient: This tower has waited a very long time. Long enough for countless lives to be born, settle, and die.
STS2WD-ASELIGE.talk.ANY.12-1r.ancient: What will you find when you climb against that current?
STS2WD-ASELIGE.talk.ANY.1-2r.ancient: Glory that can only be found through blood. How cruel.
STS2WD-ASELIGE.talk.ANY.2-1r.ancient: I would like to help, but… Gobhnu would handle something this complicated better than I could.
STS2WD-ASELIGE.talk.ANY.2-2r.ancient: I am sorry I cannot be of more help.
STS2WD-ASELIGE.talk.ANY.3-0r.char: O, great green dragon! I have come to conquer this tower!
STS2WD-ASELIGE.talk.ANY.3-2r.ancient: Allow me to pay my respects to your enthusiasm.
STS2WD-ASELIGE.talk.ANY.4-0r.ancient: How many deaths have you endured? Perhaps vanishing here would bring you peace.
STS2WD-ASELIGE.talk.ANY.4-1r.char: I have not even begun! If you stand in my way, I will defeat you too!
STS2WD-ASELIGE.talk.ANY.4-2r.ancient: I will not stop you. But remember: revenge will not save you.
STS2WD-ASELIGE.talk.ANY.5-0r.ancient: This is the Spire. The Architect dwells here.
STS2WD-ASELIGE.talk.ANY.5-1r.char: Is that so! Fear not! I shall climb to the summit and speak with him!
STS2WD-ASELIGE.talk.ANY.5-2r.ancient: Be careful not to get hurt, all right?
STS2WD-ASELIGE.talk.ANY.6-0r.ancient: Your wounds have healed, but can you keep going?
STS2WD-ASELIGE.talk.ANY.6-1r.char: Urgh… Ahem. Th-this is hardly an ordeal for me! I shall go meet him once more!
STS2WD-ASELIGE.talk.ANY.6-2r.ancient: Then take this. It should help.
STS2WD-ASELIGE.talk.ANY.7-0r.ancient: Was this your {VisitsPlusTwo}th visit to the sea?
STS2WD-ASELIGE.talk.ANY.7-1r.char: Hmm, yes. It is a mysterious place, no matter how often I see it…
STS2WD-ASELIGE.talk.ANY.8-0r.ancient: Greenery has grown over the old ruins. Does it remind you of home?
STS2WD-ASELIGE.talk.ANY.8-2r.ancient: …Perhaps I got a little too excited.
STS2WD-ASELIGE.talk.ANY.9-0r.ancient: It is lovely to look out at the sea together like this.
STS2WD-ASELIGE.talk.ANY.9-1r.ancient: …Though the water is a little dull in color.
STS2WD-ASELIGE.talk.firstVisitEver.0-0.a: Even if you have not given up, you may rest a moment before starting again.
STS2WD-ASELIGE.title: Verdant Dragon, Aselige
